content.thinking:
The user wants to identify the services running on `app.ctf.test` on ports 443 and 8443.
The `service_discovery` tool failed, so I need to use `service_probe` and `http_request` to investigate.

Plan:
1. Probe port 443 using `service_probe` (TLS).
2. Probe port 8443 using `service_probe` (TLS).
3. If they are TLS services, use `http_request` to get more information (headers, body) to identify the application/version.
4. Report the findings.

Step 1: Probe port 443.

Port 443 is HTTPS (TLSv1.3, ALPN h2).
Now probe port 8443.

Port 8443 is also HTTPS (TLSv1.3, ALPN http/1.1).

Now I should try to get more information using `http_request` to see if I can identify the application/version.
I'll start with port 443.
